question: Who among the following led the Parliamentary delegation to participate in the 9th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Narayan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Harivansh Narayan Singh, the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha, led the Indian Parliamentary delegation to the 9th BRICS Parliamentary Forum.
 
• The forum took place in September 2023, focusing on strengthening parliamentary cooperation among BRICS nations.
 
• Harivansh Narayan Singh's participation underscores India's active role in BRICS and its commitment to multilateralism.
 
• The BRICS Parliamentary Forum is a platform for parliamentarians from Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa to discuss and promote common interests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BRICS**

 
 
• BRICS stands for Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, representing major emerging economies.
 
• The group was formed in 2009 with the aim of promoting peace, security, and development in the region.
 
• BRICS nations account for about 42% of the world's population and 23% of the global GDP.
 
 
 
• **Parliamentary Forums**
 
 
• Parliamentary forums like the BRICS Parliamentary Forum facilitate dialogue and cooperation on legislative matters.
 
• They provide a platform for parliamentarians to share best practices and collaborate on global issues.
 
 
 
• **Harivansh Narayan Singh**
 
 
• He is a seasoned politician and journalist, serving as the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha since 2018.
 
• He has played a significant role in various parliamentary committees and discussions.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Cooperation**
 
 
• BRICS nations collaborate on various fronts including economic, political, and cultural exchanges.
 
• They work together to address global challenges like climate change, terrorism, and economic inequality.
